name: plugin-app-dependency-compatibility
goal: Generated Harness apps can generate both built-in browser testing plugins without dependency-version conflicts, while incompatible dependencies remain rejected.

evidence: The merged CLI scenario and a fresh generated app reject plugin generate playwright because the app pins @playwright/test 1.63.0 but the default plugin requests ^1.28.1; the exact-string admission rejects the mismatch before generating files.

The app template and plugin catalog cases check each template independently but never compare their Playwright dependency declarations. Strengthen the existing generated-app case to check both built-in plugin versions without changing its registered case count.
